common_chemical.name: Chemical Supplies (Common)
common_chemical.shortDescription: Can be unpacked into items that are useful for basic chemical crafting.
common_chemical.flavorText: A collection of common chemical supplies you could likely find in the Station Hardware Depot.

restricted_chemical.name: Chemical Supplies (Restricted)
restricted_chemical.shortDescription: Can be unpacked into items that are useful for advanced chemical crafting.
restricted_chemical.flavorText: A collection of restricted chemical supplies needed for crafting narcotics, or explosives.

common_medical.name: Medical Supplies (Common)
common_medical.flavorText: A collection of common medical supplies, mostly over-the-counter pharmacy items.

restricted_medical.name: Medical Supplies (Restricted)
restricted_medical.flavorText: A collection of restricted medical supplies, necessary for the care of the Station's infirm.

scrap_metal.name: Scrap Metal
scrap_metal.shortDescription: Can be smelted into Metal Ore. With limited resources available on the Station, salvage and recycling are important habits.

junk.name: Junk
junk.flavorText: Broken scraps and useless rubbish. Barely recyclable, worth next to nothing.

common_electronic.name: Electronic Parts (Common)
common_electronic.flavorText: An assortment of all kinds of useful, if common, electronics: connectors, switches, capacitors, processors and processing units...

rare_electronic.name: Electronic Parts (Rare)
rare_electronic.flavorText: An assortment of uncommon, high-end electronic parts. A certain inventor would be very interested in this...

hypertech_electronic.name: Electronic Parts (Hypertech)
hypertech_electronic.shortDescription: Used to upgrade or charge certain Hypertech items.
hypertech_electronic.flavorText: The bleeding edge of electronics. Nobody on the station can make these.

wire.name: Wire
wire.shortDescription: A bundle of electrical wires. From the looks of it, it was harvested from somewhere...

printer_plastic.name: 3D Printing Filament
printer_plastic.shortDescription: A spool of premium filament for use in a 3D printer. Made from recycled plastics where possible.

flux_agent.name: Flux Smelting Agent (Basic)
flux_agent.shortDescription: A useful additive that improves the purity of Metal Ore when used during smelting. It is consumed in the process.

advanced_flux_agent.name: Flux Smelting Agent (Advanced)
advanced_flux_agent.shortDescription: A useful additive that improves the purity of Metal Ore when used during smelting. Reusable.

gun_part.name: Gun Parts
gun_part.shortDescription: Obtained from disassembling firearm with a screwdriver. Can be used to refurbish used firearms. Repeated attempts will increase refurbish chance.
gun_part.flavorText: A collection of internal gun parts, including screws, springs, and other small components.

nuclear_waste.name: Radioactive Waste
nuclear_waste.shortDescription: Radioactive waste material. Handle with care.
nuclear_waste.flavorText: A collection of hazardous nuclear waste. No one wants to deal with this stuff.
